plainTranslation: Their Venus in your 1st house: they find you attractive and lovely the moment you meet, and you feel it. One of the easiest opening contacts. Failure mode: it's so flattering you mistake being adored for being known. Enjoy the warmth; let them learn the real you.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
